title: Data-Driven Decision Making in Scholarship Programs: Leveraging Decision Trees and Clustering Algorithms
authors: Espiritu, F. V.; Natividad, M. C. B.; Velasco, R. A.
venue: International Journal in Information Technology in Governance, Education and Business
tldr: Decision trees and clustering algorithms applied to BRO-Ed scholarship program in Isabela province streamline application processing and optimize budget allocation.
problem_and_motivation: The BRO-Ed scholarship program faces challenges handling a growing number of applications efficiently. Manual processes are inadequate for managing increasing application volumes.
approach: Implements decision tree and clustering algorithms for scholarship application processing.
Includes systematic data integration, preprocessing, and online platform development.
Integrates machine learning into existing scholarship management workflow.
Creates user-friendly online platform to enhance accessibility.
findings: Initial results show significant increase in success rate for scholarship processing.
Data-driven approach enables streamlined application processing and informed decisions.

definitions.definition: Scholarship program of Isabela province providing educational assistance to underprivileged students.
